comments.author: Cute-Sandwich-7207
comments.body: Keep at it you’ll get better at working with AI over time. There will be obstacles that seem insurmountable, but then suddenly get solved through collaboration with AI or even through your own brainpower! I’ve been developing with AI for almost a year now; you learn quickly if you stick with it and don’t let failed projects and ideas deter you from pressing on

replies.author: Equivalent-Yak2407
replies.body: thanks, that means a lot. already hit a couple "this is impossible" walls this week that somehow cracked a day later, so this resonates. would love to see what you've built if you want to share

comments.author: Chacudno
comments.body: Where are you getting the assets?

replies.author: Equivalent-Yak2407
replies.body: Claude drives Blender through an MCP server and models them. that's how I got a big varied library fast. it's not perfect though, AI can't nail a clean mesh every time yet, so I go back and fix the rough ones by hand.

replies.author: Chacudno
replies.body: Ah I saw a video on that yesterday, I'm already learning so much in general now I'm sure I'll add blender to the list.

replies.author: Equivalent-Yak2407
replies.body: thanks! yeah, animations are one spot AI genuinely nailed fast :D

comments.author: Neat-Gift7875
comments.body: How did you make the 3d models?

replies.author: Equivalent-Yak2407
replies.body: AI generated the 3D models using Blender MCP server. It then converted it to glb file (standard web 3d format) that three.js client loads and runtime and renders them
